name: Wavetable Bank Transport Bench
author: Rubato Audio
description: Diagnostic variable-bank Wavetable transport. Not a musical model.

controls.label: Bank transport
controls.description: Sweeps the current mirrored or one-way bank path.

controls.label: Column
controls.description: Moves across the wavetable bank's columns.

controls.label: Row
controls.description: Moves across the wavetable bank's rows.

controls.label: Configuration
controls.description: Selects 1, 2, 3, or 8 mirrored banks, then 8 or 16 one-way banks.

outputs.aux: Quantized MAIN, unless the CPU probe tone is enabled
